subject: gk
question: The JALDOOT application launched in September 2022 is used by Gram Rojgar Sahyak to measure _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**water level in well**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The current web page context reports that the** Ministry of Rural Development (MoRD), Government of India launched the JALDOOT App on September 27th, 2022 at Krishi Bhawan, New Delhi.**
 
• The app was developed to capture the water level of selected wells in a village across the country.
 
• The app will enable **Gram Rojgar Sahayak (GRS) to measure the water level of selected wells twice a year (pre-monsoon and post-monsoon).**
 
• In every village, an** adequate number of measurements will be taken to ensure that the water level is captured accurately.**
